auditVerified.before: pdfOcrOffer refused the whole PDF above eight total pages.
Native extraction stops above DOCUMENT_LIMITS.nativeBytes (10 MiB).
Batch PDF admission stops above DOCUMENT_LIMITS.originalBytes (16 MiB).
Choosing a page did not bypass the eight-total-page opening bound.

bounds.unchanged: Original bytes remain capped at 16 MiB because the existing supervised renderer has that same opening bound. Selecting a page does not bypass it. Whole-page OCR frame, rotation, region, process, output and job-history bounds remain unchanged.

change.studio: pdfOcrOffer offers a single explicit page number for longer PDFs. createPdfOcrPress preflights the pinned private page route and sends singlePage:true above eight pages. Invalid numbers cannot enqueue. Existing short-PDF selection, retry keys and candidate citation opener remain.
change.job: The existing document-extraction job skips whole-document native extraction for singlePage:true, states NATIVE_TEXT_NOT_REQUESTED, and runs the existing OCR bridge on the original. No second service, queue or original is created.
change.renderer: The existing supervised renderer opts into the 400-page selected-page profile only for OCR and private viewing. It rasterizes only the chosen page; other callers retain their eight-page default. Source hash, revision, page number, frame and page-region citations keep the existing contract.
change.words: The eight-page refusal becomes the per-page offer. PDF upload and unread-text-layer forecasts use the shared bounds; unrelated file-kind sentences and review warnings stay unchanged. Originals above the renderer byte bound still receive the existing kept/not-read words.
change.pins: documentReaderSha now includes document-pages.ts because document input bounds depend on it. OpenAPI, source pins and API-client types were regenerated.

studio.scope: Long-PDF offer, selected-page queue and invalid-page controls failed before implementation.

backend.scope: The literal test_only twelve-page PDF could not queue page 11: ocrSelection.page maximum was 8.

python.scope: Initial collection found missing fitz; this is dependency setup, not a successful renderer baseline.

invariants: A literal test_only 12-page PDF queues one selected page with the original SHA-256 and revision; the OCR result keeps page 11 and its exact top-left-points frame.
The selected-page job never invokes the whole-document native extractor; original storage bytes remain byte-identical and no records are created.
The actual PDF renderer draws only page 11; page 0, a page beyond the end, 401 total pages and an original above 16 MiB are refused.
Eight-page old/default and selected-profile rasters and their receipts are byte-identical; existing short-PDF Studio tests pass.
Both the long-PDF retry body and OCR status validate against the published schema. OCR passages remain candidates, not facts.

Actual renderer refusal before reading the original bytes; Studio's existing 26.9 MiB kept/not-read words are tested.
